description:
FILED s537a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-12), found while writing #4281's fix-forward guard row (Pl/t/tail-return-01.t row 13 had to avoid the spelling).  PRE-EXISTING: main 23f0f917 identical (a DROP announced at transpile, a die when reached).

A symbolic code call through `$_` WITH an argument list is dropped: `&$_()` / `&$_(ARGS)` in any position.

    sub a { "A" } $_ = "a"; my $x = &$_(); print "$x\n";
    # perl: A
    # PCL : PCL: statement dropped at q.pl line 1: my $x = &$_(); -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [prefix_op, tree_val]
    #       then dies "PCL: statement not supported ..." when the statement is reached

Also `print &$_(), "\n" for qw(a);`, `print scalar(&$_()), "\n" for qw(a);`, `for (qw(a)) { print scalar(&$_()), "\n" }` (all drop).  Controls that WORK: `&$n()` with `my $n = "a"` (A), `&$_` WITHOUT parens (A).

PPI is right (not a PPI bug): `my $x = &$_();` = Word my | Symbol $x | Operator = | Cast & | Magic $_ | List () | Structure ; -- the same shape as `&$n()` but with a PPI::Token::Magic where `&$n()` has a PPI::Token::Symbol.  So PExpr's `&$var(args)` reduction (the code-ref call, CLAUDE.md "&$foo(args) DONE session 62") keys on PPI::Token::Symbol and does not accept the Magic token `$_` (check the other magic scalars too: `&$1()`).  Fix: the reduction asks for a SCALAR VARIABLE token (a Symbol or a scalar Magic), one predicate; probe `&$_(1,2)`, `&{$_}()`, `$_->()`, `&$_` (works today), `goto &$_`.
subject: `&$_()` (a code-ref / symbolic call through $_ WITH parens) is DROPPED, "Fell through": PExpr reduces `&$var(args)` only for a PPI Symbol, and $_ is a Magic token
